title: Implement level-order (BFS) traversal of a binary tree
hint: Use a Queue, and for each level record the current queue size, then process exactly that many nodes while enqueuing their children.

title: Check if a binary tree is height-balanced
hint: Recursively compute subtree heights, returning a sentinel such as -1 as soon as a subtree is unbalanced, so each node is visited once.

title: Validate whether a binary tree is a valid Binary Search Tree
hint: Recurse passing a min and max bound for each node, or do an inorder traversal and check values are strictly increasing.

title: Find the Lowest Common Ancestor of two nodes in a BST and in a general binary tree
hint: For a BST, walk down using value comparison; for a general tree, recurse and return the node where both left and right searches find a target.
